Name: Sprouting Strike
Components: S, M (a seed or piece of bark)
Description: You enchant and flick the seed for rapid growth after sticking to the target. Make a ranged spell attack against a target creature within range, dealing 1 piercing damage on a hit. As a Free Action you may take after planting a seed on the creature, you may cause it to sprout into heavy vines that dig into the ground, trapping the creature in place until it is destroyed. A creature trapped this way has their movement speed reduced to 0. These vines have 20 hit points, an AC of 12, and are vulnerable to fire and slashing damage. They naturally vanish after one hour, wherein the seed also grows permanently dormant if not sprouted. You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide the casting of this spell.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the vines’ hit points increase by 10 and AC increases by 1 for each slot level above 1st.
